heading: Objective
body: Beat the dealer by getting a hand total as close to 21 as possible without going over (busting). If your hand exceeds 21, you lose automatically.

heading: Card Values
body:
Number cards (2-10) are worth their face value.
Face cards (J, Q, K) are worth 10 points each.
Aces can be worth 11 or 1 point, whichever benefits the hand more without busting.

heading: Gameplay
body:
1. Click [Deal] to start a round. You and the dealer each receive two cards. One of the dealer's cards remains hidden.

2. During your turn, you may [Hit] to draw another card or [Stand] to end your turn.

3. After you stand, the dealer reveals their hidden card and draws until reaching 17 or higher.

4. The round ends when you bust, the dealer busts, or both stand.

heading: Blackjack
body:
A 'Blackjack' (or natural 21) is an Ace plus a 10-value card (10, J, Q, K) as your first two cards. If you get Blackjack and the dealer does not, you win immediately with a bonus payout.

If both you and the dealer have Blackjack, the round is a push (tie).

heading: Winning
body:
After all cards are drawn:
- If you have a higher total than the dealer without busting, you win.
- If the dealer busts (goes over 21), you win.
- If your total matches the dealer's, the round is a push and your bet is returned.
- If you go over 21, you bust and lose regardless of the dealer's hand.

heading: Tip
body:
The dealer must hit on 16 or below and stand on 17 or above. Use this predictable behaviour to plan your strategy.

If you have a low hand (12-16) and the dealer shows a weak card (2-6), consider standing and letting the dealer risk busting.

heading: Controls
body:
[Deal] - Start a new round
[Hit] - Draw another card
[Stand] - End your turn and let the dealer play
[Menu] - Return to the game selector

Press ? to toggle this help panel.
